component.name: Xmemos
component.summary: Privacy-first, 100% offline microblogging and knowledge-capture app

description.p: Xmemos is a privacy-first, 100% offline microblogging, journaling, and personal knowledge-capture desktop and mobile application featuring 1:1 SQLite database compatibility with Official FOSS Memos.
All data is stored locally in a WAL-mode SQLite database with full-text search (FTS5), rich Markdown/KaTeX rendering, atomic backup/restore, and zero telemetry or cloud dependencies.

Accelerated cold and warm startup across Android, GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS with native Kotlin first-frame WebView tuning, zero-subprocess Win32 advapi32 WebView2 detection, native Linux NVIDIA/Wayland DE hints, Frame-0 memo hydration with instant Frame-1 window reveal, and strict bounded LRU/TTL cache pruning (48 MiB thumbs, 128 KB SWR snapshots).

Eliminated Android bottom tabbar slider jitter by removing inline Svelte transform overrides on the active Liquid Glass pill, adding touch-action: none and GPU layer containment, and adding silky PowerPoint-style directional slide page transitions via SvelteKit onNavigate and the View Transitions API with a pinned static navbar.

Added smart, crash-proof, lightweight automatic video compression using hardware-accelerated Jetpack Media3 Transformer on Android (720p max short side, adaptive bitrate, 90s watchdog, anti-bloat guard) and optional system FFmpeg on Desktop, running asynchronously off the UI thread with zero-loss passthrough fallback.

Eliminated duplicate backup saves in backups/ and cleaned staged temp exports on cancel, upgraded Rust and WebView static media compression with live per-file upload progress indicators, and added a persistent HOST/ADMIN-only Upload Size Limit setting enforced on both frontend and backend.
